messages:
Marta (Sales): Heads-up 90-min sync with NovaTech tomorrow. They want a hosted POC with one per-environment API key, IP allowlisting, a 48h rotation cadence, and a 7-day max lifetime. Can SE outline a secure provisioning flow we can promise in the SOW?
Devon (SE): We usually support that. Recommended flow: generate scoped key in Console, attach allowed-models and IP CIDRs, set TTL=168h (7d) but enable auto-rotate every 48h with new key material pushed to a secure expiring URL. We also add audit metadata for SOW.
Ravi (Sales Eng): Do we have a way to avoid emailing secrets? NovaTech wants direct S3-style expiring download to their infra account or a one-time HTTPS link.
Devon (SE): Yes 92 provision-bot can create an expiring signed URL (4h default) for the initial key, plus a one-time passphrase we store in the audit. We can also support delivering the URL to a webhook URI if they provide it.
Marta (Sales): They will provide a webhook. Also need to prove revocation will be immediate if contract halts.
Devon (SE): Revoke is immediate via Console or API. We can set an auto-revoke flag on end_date and add a support playbook entry. For emergency revoke, they should open the support ticket with key id.
Ravi (Sales Eng): Can you share the minimal curl example for their infra team?
Devon (SE): Example (token placeholder): ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_poc_PLACEHOLDER" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \ 
  -d '{"model":"embed-1","input":"hello"}'
```
Marta (Sales): Perfect. Also need to confirm audit fields: created_by, created_at, rotation_schedule, ip_allowlist, models, delivery_url, delivery_expires_at.
provision-bot: Logged audit entry: key.create id pk.poc.nova_229300 created_by Devon (SE) created_at 2293001113 rotation 48h ttl 168h ip_allowlist 203.0.113.0/24 models [embed-1, redwood-4-compat] delivery_url https://secrets.redwood/s/eyJ... expires_at 2293002713 (4h).
Devon (SE): I'll enable network enforcement and note that logs are available in Console->Audit->Network. Also recommend they pin model versions to prevent drift during POC.
Marta (Sales): Who owns rotation failures? If auto-rotate fails to generate new key, what happens?
Devon (SE): If rotation job fails, fallback is: 1) existing key remains until TTL, 2) alerts to SE oncall, 3) automatic retry window 30m x 3, 4) we can optionally fail-open to a lower-tier compatibility model for availability but only when requested. For POCs we usually keep fail-closed and alert.
Ravi (Sales Eng): Nice. Can we attach a short-term policy that forbids copy/paste? (just kidding) Seriously: we should document that long-lived infra tokens must be rotated by customer if they persist.
Devon (SE): Noted. I'll add an auto-revoke hook on POC end_date and include revocation playbook steps in the SOW: Console -> Keys -> Revoke -> Confirm, and support ticket if they need assistance.
Marta (Sales): Okay I'll add language to SOW: "Provisioned hosted API keys will be scoped, IP-restricted, auto-rotated every 48 hours and expire at 7 days; secure delivery via expiring URL or webhook; immediate revocation on request."
provision-bot: Key provisioning complete. key_id: pk.poc.nova_229300 rotation: 48h ttl: 168h delivery_url expires_in: 4h audit_ref: audit_229300_1
Devon (SE): I've teased out the curl + a short snippet for their infra: ```python
import requests
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer pk_poc_PLACEHOLDER"}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings", json={"model":"embed-1","input":"hi"}, headers=headers)
print(resp.json())
```
Marta (Sales): Great. I'll confirm the webhook details with NovaTech and update the SOW. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Sales Eng): I'll follow up after the handoff to validate logs show IP enforcement.
Devon (SE): Ping me if the download webhook needs auth; we can sign callbacks.
Marta (Sales): Closing thread once webhook confirmed.
